title: Reports
description: Sales, stock, the ledger's statements, eggs and VAT for any period, from the API, ready to export.

sales.name: Sales report
sales.about: What was sold in the period, by cashier, with the API's totals.

purchases.name: Purchases report
purchases.about: What was bought and received in the period (CR-018).

stock-valuation.name: Stock valuation
stock-valuation.about: Stock on hand at cost, never at price.

expiry.name: Expiry report
expiry.about: Lots expiring soon, so they sell or move before they spoil.

profit-and-loss.name: Profit and loss
profit-and-loss.about: Income, cost of sales and expenses from the ledger for the period.

balance-sheet.name: Balance sheet
balance-sheet.about: What the business owns and owes, and the owners' equity, at the end of a day, from the ledger.

trial-balance.name: Trial balance
trial-balance.about: Every account's opening, period and closing debits and credits, and whether the ledger balances.

egg-sales.name: Egg sales by shop
egg-sales.about: Crates and loose eggs sold at each shop and channel in the period (CR-059).

egg-margin.name: Margin per crate
egg-margin.about: Cost, price and margin per crate after breakage, from the server (CR-059).

egg-breakage.name: Egg breakage
egg-breakage.about: Eggs written off by reason and shop, at cost (CR-059).

egg-valuation.name: Egg stock valuation
egg-valuation.about: Crates and loose eggs on hand at each shop at the end of a day, at cost (CR-059).

vat-return.name: VAT return
vat-return.about: VAT, NHIL and GETFund charged and reclaimable in the period, and what is due (CR-060).

emptyBody: Try a longer period or another branch.
denied: You do not have access to this report
negative: A net loss for the period
queued: The file is being prepared. It appears in report runs when it is ready.
waits: This report waits for the backend ({{request}}). It runs here as soon as the API lists it.
negativeBalance: A negative balance at the date
checksPassed_other: All {{count}} of the statement's checks passed
checksFailed_one: {{count}} check on this statement failed. Ask the accountant before relying on it.
checksFailed_other: {{count}} checks on this statement failed. Ask the accountant before relying on it.

tb.totalDebit: Debits in the period, every account
tb.totalCredit: Credits in the period, every account
tb.balanced: The trial balance balances: debits equal credits and the closing balances net to zero.
tb.notBalanced: The trial balance does not balance
tb.notBalancedBody: Debits and credits differ. The ledger has raised an alert; ask the accountant before relying on any statement.
